summary.text: Consuelo Redhorse is the Democratic candidate for Colorado House of Representatives District 13 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican Miguel Martinez in a race with no incumbent.
She is president of the Summit School District Board of Education, according to her Ballotpedia survey responses.

paragraphs.text: Consuelo Redhorse was born in Boulder, Colorado, graduated from Longmont High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Fort Lewis College in 2001.
Her career experience includes accounting and small business.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a member of the Navajo Nation and a lifelong Coloradan, and said her work has included financial audits for nonprofits and homeowners associations and managing finances and operations for a small bookstore and a local property manager.
Redhorse said in the survey that, as a member of the Summit School District board, she helped lead the district through COVID recovery, leadership changes and budget pressures.
She won the June 30, 2026 Democratic primary for House District 13, defeating Chris Floyd.
Ballotpedia lists her affiliations as including Summit High School Pre-Collegiate, the Summit County Animal Shelter, the Sierra Club and Girl Scouts of Colorado.
